result.brief: 提出深度特征监督的结构感知视觉tokenizer（DAE）与源条件布朗桥扩散Transformer，用于胸片骨抑制，并发布大规模配对数据集。
result.reason: Introduces Depth Auto-Encoder, a structure-aware vision tokenizer with depth-feature loss for latent compression, directly addressing reconstruction-biased latent compression relevant to RAE/generative latent spaces.
